Availability depends on the organization's billing plan; check `enabled` before using a slug.

created_at.description: The webhook creation timestamp.

enabled.description: Whether the webhook is enabled.

id.description: The webhook ID.

project_id.description: The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

updated_at.description: The webhook last update timestamp.
